name: Mesuga** Choukyou ~Dekachin ni Kusshita Shoujo-tachi~
original_name: メスガ●調教～デカチンに屈した少女たち～
source:
The protagonist is an unemployed shut-in.
By his parents' help, he starts working as a private tutor.
However, his student named Rinka looks down on him taking a cold attitude to him with a number of bad-mouths. Due to his patient personality, two of his other students, Minori and Julina come to do the same as Rinka to him...

In days of being bullied by cocky girls, his patience is about to run out...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE240831.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角是一个失业的宅男。
在父母的帮助下，他开始担任私人教师。
然而，他的学生林卡却瞧不起他，对他态度冷淡，说了很多坏话。由于他的耐心性格，他的另外两个学生Minori和Julina也对他做了和Rinka一样的事情……

在被狂妄女孩欺负的日子里，他的耐心快要耗尽了……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE240831.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
